name: Ventura County Behavioral Health
description: Longstanding partner co-developing and funding LGBTQ+ cultural competency curriculum, mental health awareness, and suicide prevention resources across Ventura County.

name: Ventura County Public Health
description: Collaborative clinical partner supplying rapid testing kits, lab support, vaccine distribution (MPOX/Flu), and harm reduction materials for Diversity SHINES.

name: The Transverse
description: Grassroots trans peer group partner co-hosting bi-weekly transgender and non-binary social circles at the Community Resource Center.

name: PFLAG Ventura
description: Dedicated family education and peer support chapter meeting monthly at DCVC to strengthen ties between LGBTQ+ individuals and their families.
